instructions.name: close_price_feed
docs: Close a PriceFeed. Signer is `config.authority`. Rent goes to `config.keeper`.

instructions.name: close_run_receipts
docs: Close legacy RunRecord / RunPrice accounts. Rent goes to `config.keeper`.

instructions.name: close_user
docs: Close the USDC vault (must be empty) and UserConfig. Rent goes to the owner.

instructions.name: execute_buy
docs: Keeper crank: owner is not a signer. Bot pays fees; vault PDA spends USDC.
`skip_cooldown`: when true (enable force-buy), do not enforce 7-day last_run_ts cooldown.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config: only config.keeper may crank execute_buy.

instructions.name: execute_buy_v2
docs: Keeper crank of a priced buy. Same cooldown and last_run_ts rules as execute_buy.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config: only config.keeper may crank execute_buy_v2.

accounts.name: run_price
docs: space and seeds as `init`, payer = keeper) so this struct does not inline a second `init`.

instructions.name: execute_buy_v3
docs: Keeper crank of a priced buy. `fee_usdc` is the keeper's cost quote for this buy.
The program caps it by `FeeConfig.max_fee_usdc` and `MAX_FEE_USDC`. Zero skips the transfer.
When `FeeConfig.enabled` is false the buy still runs, but only with `fee_usdc == 0`.
v2 is unchanged.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config: only config.keeper may crank.

accounts.name: fee_usdc_ata
docs: in `check_fee_ata` (same failures as the associated-token constraint plus mint).

instructions.name: execute_buy_v4
docs: Keeper crank of a priced buy. Writes the last-buy card. No RunRecord / RunPrice.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global config: only config.keeper may crank.

accounts.name: fee_usdc_ata
docs: in `check_fee_ata` (same failures as the associated-token constraint plus mint).

instructions.name: init_fee_config
docs: Create the single fee-config PDA. Signer must be `config.authority`.

instructions.name: migrate_user
docs: Realloc a 59-byte UserConfig to 305 B and write the last-buy card.
`payer` is the owner, `config.keeper`, or `config.authority`.

accounts.name: user_config
docs: deserialize as the new UserConfig.

instructions.name: set_fee_config
docs: Update the existing fee-config PDA. Signer must be `config.authority`.

instructions.name: set_price
docs: Keeper or config authority sets the USD price for one stock mint.

instructions.name: simulate_buy_v2
docs: Owner-signed buy. Mints floor(usdc/price) of each token. Does not touch last_run_ts.

accounts.name: run_price
docs: space and seeds as `init`) so this struct does not inline a second `init`.

instructions.name: simulate_buy_v3
docs: Owner-signed priced buy. Writes the last-buy card. Does not touch last_run_ts.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: TooSoon
errors.msg: Too soon: wait 7 days since last run

errors.name: InvalidFeeWallet
errors.msg: Fee wallet is the default pubkey

errors.name: RunIndexMismatch
errors.msg: Run index does not follow the card

errors.name: InvalidReceipt
errors.msg: Account is not a valid run receipt

errors.name: InvalidRentReceiver
errors.msg: Rent receiver must be the keeper

types.name: FeeConfig
docs: Global fee configuration PDA. Seeds = [b"fee_config"].
One account. The per-buy amount is an argument of `execute_buy_v3`, not a stored constant.
`max_fee_usdc` is the admin cap and must stay <= `MAX_FEE_USDC`.

types.name: PriceFeed
docs: USD price for one stock mint. PDA seeds = [b"price", mint].
`price` is USD per one whole token, scaled by 10^price_decimals.

types.name: ProgramConfig
docs: Global program config PDA (seeds = [b"config"]).
Stores the sole authorized keeper for execute_buy.
